author: CreeperReaperX
body:
Sorry to bother anyone who doesn't want to look over this, but I have tried unsuccessfully to find a team that would even trial me. Just a few facts:

I play defense mostly, but can adapt to mid.
I have been on a few high ranked teams before.
I participated in all rounds of Conquest Inc.
After Crede disbanded, I tried to find a lot of teams but as I said, none would trial me.
I have discord (CreeperReaperX#8630) and Teamspeak

Thanks for looking over this I guess, and if you're a team that needs a few players, I'm all ears.

Thank you,
               CreeperReaperX
